attributes.name: attorney_firm
attributes.description: Law firm or legal practice of the estate planning attorney.

attributes.name: attorney_name
attributes.description: Name of the estate planning attorney or legal advisor who prepared the planned giving documentation.

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: Date when the donor formally committed to the planned gift arrangement, typically when legal documentation was executed.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has requested that the planned gift remain confidential and not be publicly acknowledged or included in donor recognition materials.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Discount rate applied for present value calculations of future planned gift proceeds. Typically based on IRS Section 7520 rate or organizational cost of capital.

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the organization received formal legal documentation of the planned gift (e.g., copy of will provision, trust agreement, beneficiary designation form).

attributes.name: estate_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the donor's estate plan, will, or trust document that contains the planned gift provision. May include estate case number or trust name.

attributes.name: estimated_value
attributes.description: Estimated present or future value of the planned gift in the organization's functional currency. For bequests, this represents the estimated bequest amount; for trusts and annuities, the expected remainder value.

attributes.name: estimated_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: financial_advisor_firm
attributes.description: Financial advisory firm or wealth management company of the financial advisor.

attributes.name: financial_advisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial advisor or wealth manager involved in the planned giving arrangement.

attributes.name: gift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planned gift. Tracks progression from pending notification through active commitment to maturity, realization, or potential revocation.

attributes.name: gift_vehicle_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subtype of the planned gift vehicle, such as CRUT (Charitable Remainder Unitrust), CRAT (Charitable Remainder Annuity Trust), or specific bequest type (residual, specific, contingent).

attributes.name: legacy_society_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has been inducted into the organization's legacy society or planned giving recognition program as a result of this commitment.

attributes.name: legal_documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of the legal documentation supporting the planned gift. Tracks progression from verbal intent through executed legal documents to verification and potential revocation.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Expected date when the planned gift will be realized by the organization. For life-contingent gifts, this may be estimated based on actuarial life expectancy; for term trusts, this is the trust termination date.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the planned gift arrangement, including special conditions, donor intentions, stewardship activities, or coordination details.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the organization was formally notified of the planned giving intention by the donor, estate attorney, or financial advisor.

attributes.name: planned_gift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planned giving vehicle. Includes bequest intentions, charitable remainder trusts (CRT), charitable lead trusts (CLT), charitable gift annuities (CGA), life insurance policy assignments, and retained life estate arrangements.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Life insurance policy number if the planned gift is a life insurance assignment or beneficiary designation.

attributes.name: present_value
attributes.description: Present value of the planned gift calculated by discounting the estimated future value to current dollars using the discount rate and expected maturity date.

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0-100%) that the planned gift will be realized, based on documentation status, donor age, relationship strength, and other factors. Used for revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: realization_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the planned gift was received and converted to a realized gift. Populated when the gift transitions from planned to actual.

attributes.name: realized_value
attributes.description: Actual value received when the planned gift was realized. May differ from estimated value due to market changes, estate settlement, or other factors.

attributes.name: recognition_preference
attributes.description: Donor's preference for recognition of the planned gift. Options include public recognition, anonymous giving, inclusion in legacy society, or no recognition.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planned giving record was first created in the system of record.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this planned giving record.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planned giving record was last modified in the system of record.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Net asset classification of the planned gift proceeds per ASC 958. Indicates whether the gift will be unrestricted, temporarily restricted (purpose or time), or permanently restricted (endowment).

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the planned gift was revoked or withdrawn by the donor. Populated if the donor amends their estate plan to remove the organization as beneficiary.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for revocation of the planned gift, if known. May include change in financial circumstances, change in philanthropic priorities, or family considerations.

attributes.name: stewardship_tier
attributes.description: Stewardship tier or level assigned to this planned giving donor for cultivation and engagement purposes. May correspond to estimated gift value ranges or donor relationship status.

attributes.name: trust_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the charitable trust (CRT or CLT) if applicable. May include trust name, trust tax ID, or trustee reference number.

attributes.name: valuation_date

products.name: appeal_targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between fundraising appeals and donor segments. It captures the operational execution of multi-segment direct marketing campaigns where a single appeal is deployed to multiple constituent segments with segment-specific performance tracking. Each record links one appeal to one donor segment with attributes that measure the effectiveness of that specific appeal-segment combination including pieces sent, response metrics, revenue attribution, and ROI analysis.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit fundraising operations, appeals routinely target multiple donor segments simultaneously with segment-specific execution parameters (different ask amounts for major vs. annual donors, different creative variants for A/B testing, wave-based deployment schedules). Each appeal-segment combination generates its own performance metrics (pieces sent, response rate, revenue, ROI) that fundraisers actively analyze to optimize future targeting decisions. This is not a theoretical correlation but an operational business process where development teams create targeting plans, execute multi-segment campaigns, and measure segment-level results.

attributes.name: appeal_targeting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this appeal-segment targeting record. Primary key.

attributes.name: appeal_donor_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the donor_segment product

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fundraising appeal being deployed to this segment

attributes.name: appeal_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the donor segment being targeted by this appeal

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member who created this targeting assignment.

attributes.name: average_gift_amount
attributes.description: Average gift size for responses from this segment to this appeal, calculated as total_revenue_amount / response_count. Used to compare segment giving capacity.

attributes.name: cost_allocated
attributes.description: Portion of the total appeal cost allocated to this segment based on pieces sent or other cost allocation methodology. Enables segment-level ROI calculation.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated cost amount.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appeal-segment targeting record was created in the system.

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal was deployed to this specific segment. May differ from overall appeal mailing_date if segments are deployed in waves.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when performance metrics for this appeal-segment combination were last updated.

attributes.name: pieces_sent
attributes.description: Number of solicitation pieces (letters, emails, calls) sent specifically to constituents in this segment for this appeal. This is segment-specific volume tracking.

attributes.name: response_count
attributes.description: Number of constituents from this segment who responded to this appeal with a gift or pledge. Enables segment-level response analysis.

attributes.name: response_rate_percent
attributes.description: Response rate percentage for this specific appeal-segment combination, calculated as (response_count / pieces_sent) * 100. Critical metric for segment performance evaluation.

attributes.name: revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the segment revenue amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: roi_ratio
attributes.description: Return on investment ratio for this appeal-segment combination, calculated as total_revenue_amount / cost_allocated. Critical metric for optimizing future segment targeting decisions.

attributes.name: segment_ask_amount
attributes.description: Suggested gift amount presented to constituents in this segment, which may differ from the general appeal ask_amount based on segment giving capacity (e.g., major donors receive higher asks).

attributes.name: target_segment
attributes.description: Description of the constituent segment targeted by this appeal (e.g., lapsed donors 12-24 months, major gift prospects $10K+, monthly sustainers). When an appeal targets multiple segments (e.g., 'Major Donors', 'LYBUNT Q1', 'Mid-Level Annual'), this single STRING field would require concatenation or comma-separated values, making it impossible to query segment-specific performance. This attribute should be removed from appeal as the relationship is now properly modeled through the appeal_targeting association.]

attributes.name: test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier for A/B test variant or creative package version used for this segment (e.g., 'Control', 'Variant_A', 'High_Ask'). Enables multivariate testing across segments.

attributes.name: total_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated by gifts and pledges from this segment in response to this appeal. Enables segment-level revenue attribution and ROI calculation.

products.name: event_registration
products.description: This association product represents the registration and attendance relationship between constituents and fundraising events. It captures the complete lifecycle of constituent participation in donor cultivation and fundraising activities, from initial registration through post-event follow-up. Each record links one constituent to one fundraising event with transactional attributes including registration details, ticketing information, seating assignments, payment tracking, attendance confirmation, and stewardship workflow status. This is a core operational entity managed actively by development and events staff for capacity planning, revenue tracking, donor engagement measurement, and post-event cultivation workflows.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit fundraising operations, constituents register for and attend multiple fundraising events over their donor lifecycle (galas, golf tournaments, cultivation dinners), and each event hosts multiple constituent attendees. Event registration is an actively managed operational process with its own lifecycle: registration → payment → seating assignment → check-in → post-event follow-up. This is distinct from gift processing—not all attendees make gifts, and registration data (ticket type, table assignment, dietary restrictions, attendance confirmation) is managed separately from donation transactions.

products.name: participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation event between constituent and campaign. It captures every instance of constituent engagement with a fundraising campaign, including solicitation attempts, responses, gifts, pledges, volunteer activities, and advocacy actions. Each record links one constituent to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement instance.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit fundraising operations, constituents participate in multiple campaigns over time (annual fund, emergency appeals, capital campaigns, etc.), and each campaign engages multiple constituents through various solicitation channels. Campaign participation is a recognized business concept that fundraising teams actively manage, track, and analyze. The relationship carries rich operational data including participation type, solicitation channel, response outcomes, gift/pledge amounts, and volunteer hours that belong to neither the constituent nor the campaign alone but to each specific engagement instance.

products.name: segment_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between constituents and donor segments. It captures the assignment of constituents to fundraising and stewardship segments for targeted communication, cultivation, and reporting. Each record links one constituent to one donor segment with temporal, attribution, and scoring attributes that exist only in the context of this specific membership assignment.. Existence Justification: Constituent segmentation is a core operational fundraising process where nonprofits actively manage multi-dimensional segment assignments. Constituents simultaneously belong to multiple segments (e.g., a major donor can be in 'Major Donors 2024', 'LYBUNT Q1', 'East Coast Region', and 'Health Program Interest' at the same time), and each segment contains many constituents. The business manages segment membership as a distinct lifecycle with assignment rules, temporal tracking, scoring attribution, and transition history for targeted cultivation, stewardship, and campaign execution.

products.name: indicator_funding
products.description: This association product represents the funding relationship between a constituent (donor/funder) and a specific MEL indicator. It captures donor-specific funding allocations, restrictions, targets, and reporting requirements for individual indicators across programs and grants. Each record links one constituent to one indicator with funding terms, amounts, timeframes, and performance targets that exist only in the context of this donor-indicator funding relationship. Essential for donor-specific impact reporting, compliance with funder restrictions, and tracking indicator-level funding sources.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit operations, donors (bilateral agencies like USAID/DFID, multilateral organizations, foundations) fund specific MEL indicators across multiple programs and grants, and each indicator receives funding from multiple donor sources. The business actively manages these donor-indicator funding relationships with specific funding amounts, timeframes, restrictions (unrestricted vs. earmarked), donor-specific targets, and reporting frequencies that differ by donor. This is a recognized operational concept called 'Donor Indicator Funding' or 'Indicator-Level Funding Allocation' that program managers and MEL officers actively create, track, and report on for donor compliance and impact reporting.

products.name: event_volunteer_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of volunteers to fundraising events. It captures the specific role, shift timing, and attendance tracking for each volunteer serving at each event. Each record links one fundraising event to one volunteer with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, enabling event staffing management, volunteer coordination, and post-event reporting.. Existence Justification: Fundraising events require multiple volunteers serving in different operational roles (registration, setup, catering, cleanup), and volunteers serve at multiple events throughout the year. The nonprofit actively manages event volunteer assignments as a distinct operational process, coordinating staffing needs, assigning specific roles and shifts, tracking attendance via check-in/check-out, and recording hours worked for each volunteer at each event. This is not a derived correlation but an operational entity that event managers create, update, and monitor.

products.name: assessment_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between field assessments and volunteers who serve as enumerators or team members. It captures the operational reality that assessments are conducted by multi-person teams, and volunteers participate in multiple assessments over time. Each record links one assessment to one volunteer with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific participation: the volunteer's role in that assessment, their performance metrics, and training completion status for that particular assessment methodology.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit field operations, assessments (FGDs, KIIs, household surveys, PDM, MUAC screening) are conducted by multi-person enumerator teams, and volunteers participate in multiple assessments over time across different projects and methodologies. The business actively manages assessment participation as an operational entity: field coordinators recruit volunteers for specific assessments, assign roles (lead vs. enumerator), track data quality scores per volunteer per assessment, verify methodology-specific training completion, and use this data for volunteer performance management and future assignment decisions.

products.name: distribution_participation

products.name: bid
products.description: This association product represents the Bid or Quotation submitted by a vendor in response to a Request for Quotation (RFQ). It captures the complete bid submission including pricing, technical proposal, evaluation scores, and award decision. Each record links one RFQ to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific bid submission. Essential for procurement audit trails, competitive bidding transparency, and donor compliance reporting per 2 CFR 200 procurement standards.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian procurement operations, RFQs are issued to multiple vendors during competitive bidding processes, and each vendor submits a formal bid with pricing, technical proposals, and delivery terms. The business actively manages each bid submission through evaluation scoring, ranking, and award decisions. This is not a simple reference but an operational business entity that procurement officers create, evaluate, and audit for donor compliance per 2 CFR 200 standards.

attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether this bid was awarded the contract. Only one bid per RFQ should have awarded_flag = True.

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bid: submitted (received), under_evaluation (being scored), responsive (meets requirements), non_responsive (disqualified), awarded (won contract), not_awarded (lost), withdrawn (vendor withdrew).

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bid amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: financial_score
attributes.description: Score assigned during financial evaluation of the bid based on pricing competitiveness and value for money.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.description: Ranking position of this bid among all responsive bids for the RFQ, based on total_score (1 = highest ranked).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the bid was rejected or deemed non-responsive (e.g., late submission, missing documents, failed technical requirements, price exceeds budget).

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: validity_days
attributes.description: Number of days from submission date during which the vendor commits to honor the quoted price and terms.

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: This association product represents the line-item detail of procurement purchase orders, capturing the specific commodities ordered on each PO. Each record links one purchase order to one commodity with line-specific quantities, pricing, delivery schedules, and receipt tracking. This is the operational record that procurement officers create when building multi-line purchase orders and that warehouse staff update when receiving shipments.. products.name: commodity_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the prequalification and supply agreement between a humanitarian commodity and a partner organization. It captures the partner's capacity and terms to supply specific commodities, including agreed pricing, lead times, quality certifications, and historical performance. Each record links one commodity to one partner organization with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship. Used for sourcing decisions, RFQ targeting, and localization strategy in humanitarian procurement.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian supply chain operations, partner organizations are prequalified to supply specific commodities based on capacity assessments, certifications, and past performance. A single commodity (e.g., water purification tablets) can be sourced from multiple prequalified partners at different unit costs and lead times, and a single partner organization can supply multiple different commodities (e.g., WASH items, shelter materials, medical supplies). The business actively manages these supply agreements as operational records with partner-specific pricing, lead times, quality certifications, and performance ratings.

attributes.description: Donor or organizational budget line code associated with this supply category for financial planning, expenditure tracking, and donor reporting. Maps to programme budget structures in SAP and eTools.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the supply category, aligned with ICON procurement commodity codes and SAP MM material group codes (e.g., 'MED-001', 'WASH-003'). Used as the primary lookup key across procurement and logistics systems.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the supply category, including the types of items it encompasses, intended use in humanitarian operations, and any scope boundaries.

attributes.name: category_name

attributes.name: category_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the supply category used in dashboards, reports, and space-constrained UI elements (e.g., 'MED', 'WASH', 'FOOD').

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply category record: active (in use for procurement), inactive (suspended), phased_out (retired from use), or under_review (pending reclassification or update).

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the supply category by nature of the item: commodity (bulk goods), service (contracted services), equipment (durable assets), consumable (single-use items), or non_food_item (NFI). Drives procurement rules and asset management treatment.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this supply category require temperature-controlled cold chain storage and transport (True), such as vaccines, blood products, or certain pharmaceuticals. Triggers cold chain logistics planning and monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are classified as controlled substances (e.g., narcotic pharmaceuticals, dual-use chemicals) requiring special import permits, chain-of-custody documentation, and regulatory compliance under national and international law.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply category record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: customs_duty_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are eligible for customs duty exemption under host country agreements, UN privileges and immunities, or humanitarian exemption frameworks. Drives customs documentation requirements.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this supply category record is valid and available for use in procurement transactions. Supports temporal validity management in SAP MM and ICON procurement.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date after which this supply category record is no longer valid for new procurement transactions. Null indicates an open-ended validity period. Supports category lifecycle management.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger account code to which procurement expenditure for this supply category is posted. Ensures correct financial coding for donor fund accounting, budget monitoring, and IPSAS-compliant financial statements.

attributes.name: harmonized_system_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization Harmonized System (HS) tariff code for the supply category, used for customs clearance, import/export documentation, and duty exemption applications in humanitarian operations.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are classified as hazardous materials (HAZMAT) under IATA/IMDG/ADR regulations, requiring special packaging, labelling, transport documentation, and handling procedures.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this category within the commodity taxonomy hierarchy. Level 1 = top-level segment, Level 2 = family, Level 3 = class, Level 4 = commodity, consistent with UNSPSC hierarchy conventions.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full materialized path string representing the category's position in the taxonomy tree (e.g., 'Supplies > Medical > Pharmaceuticals > Antibiotics'). Facilitates roll-up reporting without recursive queries.

attributes.name: import_license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category require an import license or permit from host country authorities prior to shipment. Triggers pre-clearance workflow in ICON procurement and logistics planning.

attributes.name: inspection_standard
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable quality inspection standard or specification for items in this category (e.g., 'ISO 2859-1', 'WHO GMP', 'UNICEF Supply Division Technical Specification'). Used to guide procurement quality assurance activities.

attributes.name: interagency_standard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply category is covered by an inter-agency standard item catalogue (e.g., IAPSO, UNICEF Supply Division catalogue, WFP standard items). Enables cross-agency procurement collaboration and joint procurement initiatives.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply category record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from purchase order issuance to delivery at the designated delivery point for items in this category. Used for supply planning, reorder point calculation, and emergency response preparedness.

attributes.name: long_term_agreement_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are eligible for procurement under a Long-Term Agreement (LTA) or framework contract, enabling faster procurement and volume discounts. Drives LTA establishment decisions in ICON procurement.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at the time of receipt or delivery for items in this category. Items not meeting this threshold are rejected. Standard procurement quality control requirement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, procurement guidance, or special handling instructions relevant to this supply category. Not used for structured data; intended for human-readable supplementary information.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category have a limited shelf life and are subject to expiry management, FEFO (First Expired First Out) stock rotation, and disposal protocols.

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: High-level procurement classification distinguishing goods, works, services, or consultancy. Determines applicable procurement rules, thresholds, and approval workflows under UN Financial Regulations and donor compliance requirements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category require pre-shipment or post-receipt quality inspection by a third-party inspection agency or internal quality assurance team before acceptance.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity

attributes.name: secondary_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: source_system_category_id
attributes.description: Native identifier of this supply category in the originating source system (e.g., SAP MM material group key, ICON commodity code). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: sphere_standard_reference

attributes.name: standard_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: strategic_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are designated as strategic pre-positioned stock for emergency response (True) or standard replenishment stock (False). Drives warehouse pre-positioning decisions and emergency release protocols.

attributes.name: unit_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric conversion factor between the standard unit of measure and the secondary unit of measure (e.g., 1 CTN = 24 EA → factor = 24.000000). Used in SAP MM unit conversion and logistics volume calculations.

attributes.name: unspsc_code

attributes.name: valuation_method

attributes.name: version_number

Links partner vetting to legal compliance status.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the partner organization against recognized humanitarian or development standards such as the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS), HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership), or equivalent national accreditation bodies.

attributes.name: annual_budget_usd
attributes.description: Most recently reported annual organizational budget of the partner in US Dollars. Used for financial capacity assessment, sub-award sizing decisions, and due diligence under OMB Uniform Guidance. Sourced from partner financial disclosures or audited accounts.

attributes.name: authorized_rep_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual legally authorized to sign agreements (MoUs, LoAs, SoWs, sub-award agreements) on behalf of the partner organization. Required for agreement execution and legal compliance.

attributes.name: authorized_rep_title
attributes.description: Official title of the authorized signatory at the partner organization (e.g., Executive Director, CEO, Country Representative). Validates signing authority for sub-award and partnership agreements.

attributes.name: bank_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the partner organization's primary bank account is held. Used for international wire transfer compliance and OFAC/sanctions screening.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary banking institution used by the partner organization for receiving sub-grant disbursements. Required for financial due diligence and sub-award payment processing in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal partner capacity assessment was conducted. Used to determine whether a reassessment is due and to track the currency of due diligence records.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) resulting from the most recent formal partner capacity assessment covering governance, financial management, HR, and program delivery. Used to determine sub-award eligibility, required oversight level, and capacity-strengthening needs under OMB Uniform Guidance.

attributes.name: chs_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner organization holds a valid Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) certification. CHS certification demonstrates commitment to accountability, quality, and improvement in humanitarian response.

attributes.name: cluster_memberships
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of OCHA humanitarian cluster(s) in which the partner organization holds active membership or co-lead roles (e.g., WASH, Health, Shelter, Food Security, Protection). Used for coordination mapping and IASC working group engagement tracking.

attributes.name: partner_org_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the partner org classification or category.

attributes.name: countries_of_operation
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the partner organization has active field operations. Distinct from country of registration. Used for geographic coverage analysis and OCHA 3W (Who does What Where) reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the created event occurred for this partner org.

attributes.name: partner_org_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description providing context about the partner org.

attributes.name: due_diligence_status
attributes.description: Current status of the partner organization's due diligence vetting process. 'Expired' indicates that a previously completed assessment has passed its validity period and renewal is required before new agreements can be executed.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the end event occurred for this partner org.

attributes.name: finance_contact_email

attributes.name: founding_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the partner organization was founded or established. Used to assess organizational maturity, track record, and eligibility for capacity-strengthening programs.

attributes.name: hact_risk_rating
attributes.description: Current HACT risk rating from most recent micro assessment (Low, Medium, Significant, High).

attributes.name: hq_country

products.name: agreement_amendment
products.description: Transactional record capturing formal modifications to existing partnership agreements including scope changes, budget realignments, no-cost extensions, period of performance adjustments, and signatory changes. Tracks amendment number, amendment type, effective date, justification, approval authority, and the specific clauses modified. Maintains the full amendment history of each agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each formal modification record to a partnership agreement. Serves as the primary key for the agreement_amendment entity.

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent partnership agreement (MoU, LoA, SoW, or sub-award) that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating agreement record.

attributes.name: primary_agreement_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member record of the individual who formally approved this amendment. Links to the workforce domain for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for this amendment within the context of the parent agreement (e.g., AMD-2024-001). Used in official correspondence, donor reporting, and compliance filings. Supports full amendment history tracking per agreement.

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment record. Draft indicates preparation in progress; pending_approval indicates submission to approval authority; approved indicates fully executed; rejected indicates declined by approver; superseded indicates replaced by a subsequent amendment; withdrawn indicates retracted before approval.

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the purpose of the amendment (e.g., 'No-Cost Extension to December 2025', 'Budget Realignment Q3 2024'). Used in correspondence, dashboards, and partner communications.

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal modification being made to the agreement. Scope change alters deliverables or geographic coverage; budget realignment redistributes funds across cost categories; no-cost extension extends the period without additional funding; period of performance adjusts start/end dates; signatory change updates authorized representatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scope_change|budget_realignment|no_cost_extension|period_of_performance|signatory_change|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual, committee, or organizational body with delegated authority to approve this amendment (e.g., Country Director, Grants Manager, Donor Agreement Officer). Supports RACI accountability tracking.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Null if not yet approved or if rejected/withdrawn.

attributes.name: beneficiary_target_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the target beneficiary numbers, population groups, or vulnerability criteria for the program. True = beneficiary targets modified; False = no change. Relevant for MEL/MEAL reporting and SDG indicator tracking.

attributes.name: budget_change_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary change to the agreement budget introduced by this amendment (revised_budget_amount minus original_budget_amount). Positive values indicate budget increases; negative values indicate reductions. Null for non-financial amendments.

attributes.name: clauses_modified
attributes.description: Enumeration or description of the specific agreement clauses, articles, or sections that are modified by this amendment (e.g., 'Article 3 — Scope of Work, Article 7 — Budget'). Supports legal review and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: agreement_amendment_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the agreement amendment classification or category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this amendment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements under 2 CFR 200 and FASB ASC 958.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this amendment record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency partnership portfolios.

attributes.name: agreement_amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description providing context about the agreement amendment.

attributes.name: document_reference

attributes.name: donor_approval_reference

attributes.name: donor_prior_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires prior written approval from the donor or prime recipient before implementation, as mandated under 2 CFR 200.308 or specific award terms. True = prior approval required; False = notification only or no approval needed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment becomes legally binding and operationally effective. This is the real-world event date, distinct from the signature date or record creation timestamp. Critical for period-of-performance tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the end event occurred for this agreement amendment.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required signatories formally signed and executed the amendment document. May differ from the effective date when retroactive amendments are issued.

attributes.name: extension_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the period of performance is extended by this amendment. Null for non-extension amendments. Used for program planning, resource allocation, and donor reporting on timeline changes.

attributes.name: geographic_scope_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the geographic coverage or operational areas of the agreement (e.g., adding or removing districts, countries, or OCHA cluster areas). True = geographic scope modified; False = no geographic change.

attributes.name: gms_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this amendment as recorded in the Grant Management System (GMS) or donor's award management platform (e.g., USAID ASIST, DFID ARIES). Enables cross-system reconciliation and donor audit support.

attributes.name: revised_end_date

attributes.name: agreement_amendment_status
attributes.description: Current status indicator for the agreement amendment workflow state.

attributes.name: submitted_date

attributes.description: Date on which this risk was formally escalated to senior management, the board, or the donor. Null if escalation has not occurred. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has been flagged for escalation to senior management, the board, or the donor (True). Set automatically when risk_level is 'critical' or when safeguarding_risk_flag is True.

attributes.name: fiduciary_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk entry has been classified as a fiduciary risk (True) involving financial management, fund accountability, or procurement integrity concerns. Triggers enhanced financial monitoring protocols.

attributes.name: financial_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Estimated maximum financial exposure in US Dollars associated with this risk, representing the value of funds at risk if the risk materialises (e.g., sub-award value at risk of misappropriation). Used in fiduciary risk prioritisation and BvA oversight.

attributes.name: impact_rating
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the severity of consequences if the risk materialises: 1=Negligible, 2=Minor, 3=Moderate, 4=Major, 5=Catastrophic. Assessed across financial, programmatic, reputational, and safeguarding dimensions.

attributes.name: inherent_impact_rating
attributes.description: Impact rating (1–5) assessed BEFORE any mitigation controls are applied. Together with inherent_likelihood_rating, establishes the gross risk score prior to control application.

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Likelihood rating (1–5) assessed BEFORE any mitigation controls are applied. Captures the gross/inherent risk level to benchmark the effectiveness of mitigation measures.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk entry was most recently reviewed and updated by the risk owner or oversight team. Used to flag stale entries requiring re-assessment.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the probability that the risk will materialise: 1=Rare, 2=Unlikely, 3=Possible, 4=Likely, 5=Almost Certain. Used in composite risk scoring per standard NGO risk matrices.

attributes.name: mitigation_measures
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific controls, actions, and safeguards implemented or planned to reduce the likelihood or impact of the risk. May include capacity-building, enhanced financial monitoring, spot-checks, or escalation protocols.

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current implementation status of the mitigation measures: planned (not yet started), in_progress (underway), completed (fully implemented), overdue (past target date without completion).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the modified event occurred for this partner risk register.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this risk entry is actively monitored and reviewed: weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or ad_hoc. Drives scheduling of oversight activities and MEL review cycles.

attributes.name: partner_risk_register_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the partner risk register.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk entry. Drives automated reminders and compliance with periodic risk review obligations under donor agreements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or supplementary information related to this risk entry that does not fit into structured fields. May include references to related incident reports, audit findings, or SitRep entries.

attributes.name: oversight_mechanism
attributes.description: Description of the specific oversight mechanism applied to manage this risk (e.g., 'Monthly financial spot-checks', 'Quarterly field monitoring visits', 'Third-party audit', 'PDM surveys'). Documents the control environment for donor compliance.

attributes.name: risk_appetite_alignment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this risk falls within the organisation's defined risk appetite: within_appetite (acceptable), at_tolerance (borderline, requires monitoring), exceeds_appetite (unacceptable, requires immediate action or sub-award suspension).

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk type: fiduciary (financial mismanagement, fraud), programmatic (delivery failure, quality gaps), reputational (media, political exposure), safeguarding (protection of beneficiaries and staff), or compliance (regulatory, donor-condition breaches).

attributes.name: risk_closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk was formally closed, either because it was fully mitigated, the sub-award ended, or the risk was deemed no longer applicable. Null if the risk remains open.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of the risk, its potential causes, and the context in which it may materialise. Supports due diligence documentation and donor compliance reporting.

attributes.name: risk_identification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk was first formally identified and entered into the risk register. Marks the start of the risk lifecycle and is used for ageing analysis.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk band derived from the composite risk score: low (1–4), medium (5–9), high (10–16), critical (17–25). Used for traffic-light reporting in MEL dashboards, donor SitReps, and sub-award oversight decisions.

attributes.name: risk_materialisation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk was confirmed to have materialised into an actual incident or adverse event. Null if the risk has not materialised. Used for incident timeline analysis and donor reporting.

attributes.name: risk_materialised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the identified risk has actually materialised into an incident or adverse event (True). When True, triggers incident management workflows and may require sub-award suspension or termination review.

attributes.name: risk_owner
attributes.description: Name or role title of the individual within the NGO responsible for monitoring and managing this risk entry. Typically a Program Manager, Grants Manager, or Country Director.

attributes.name: risk_register_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this risk entry for cross-system reference and reporting (e.g., RR-FISC-2024-0012). Used in donor reports, audit trails, and compliance filings.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk entry: open (identified, not yet addressed), under_review (being assessed), mitigated (controls applied), escalated (elevated to senior management or donor), closed (resolved or no longer applicable).

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the risk category (e.g., 'Procurement Fraud' under fiduciary, 'GBV Incident' under safeguarding, 'FCPA Violation' under compliance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: procurement_fraud|financial_misreporting|conflict_of_interest|gbv_incident|child_protection|data_breach|political_interference|media_exposure|delivery_failure|quality_failure|regulatory_breach|donor_condition_breach — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarising the risk (e.g., 'Inadequate financial controls at field office level'). Used as the primary label in risk dashboards and SitRep summaries.

attributes.name: safeguarding_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk entry involves safeguarding concerns (True), including GBV, child protection, or protection of beneficiaries and staff from exploitation and abuse. Triggers mandatory escalation per CHS safeguarding protocols.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the start event occurred for this partner risk register.

attributes.name: partner_risk_register_status
attributes.description: Current status indicator for the partner risk register workflow state.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register entry was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: mou_obligation
products.description: Tracks specific obligations, deliverables, and commitments defined within MoUs and partnership agreements. Captures obligation description, responsible party, due date, completion status, evidence of fulfillment, and escalation status. Enables systematic monitoring of whether both parties are meeting their agreed commitments under each partnership instrument.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each obligation, deliverable, or commitment record defined within an MoU or partnership agreement. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: MOU obligations frequently derive from specific award compliance requirements, donor special conditions, and regulatory flow-down clauses. Tracking which award drives each obligation is essential for

attributes.name: field_monitoring_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.field_monitoring_visit. Business justification: mou_obligation has verified_date and verified_by_name but no link to the field_monitoring_visit where verification occurred. Obligations are often verified during field monitoring visits. Adding field

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.intervention. Business justification: MOU obligations (deliverables, milestones, reporting requirements) are tied to specific program interventions for performance monitoring, results verification, and intervention-level obligation tracki

attributes.name: partnership_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent MoU, LoA, SoW, or sub-award agreement under which this obligation is defined. Links the obligation to its governing partnership instrument.

attributes.name: achieved_value
attributes.description: Actual quantitative result achieved against the target value at the time of completion or latest reporting. Enables performance tracking and BvA (Budget versus Actual) style analysis for non-financial obligations.

attributes.name: amendment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or description of the partnership agreement amendment that introduced or modified this obligation. Null for obligations defined in the original agreement. Supports change management and audit trail.

attributes.name: capacity_building_component
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this obligation includes a capacity building or institutional strengthening component for the partner organization (e.g., training, mentoring, systems development). Supports partner capacity assessment tracking.

attributes.name: cluster_lead_agency
attributes.description: Name of the OCHA cluster lead agency (e.g., UNICEF for WASH, WFP for Food Security, UNHCR for Shelter) under whose coordination framework this obligation falls. Relevant for obligations arising from cluster coordination commitments.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the mou obligation classification or category.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the obligation was fulfilled and accepted by the receiving party. Null if the obligation has not yet been completed. Used to calculate timeliness and compliance metrics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this obligation record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial_value_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when financial_value_amount is populated.

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this obligation is past its due_date without completion, as of the last system refresh. Populated only when obligation_status is 'overdue'. Used for escalation prioritization and partner performance scoring.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description providing context about the mou obligation.

attributes.name: donor_reference_number
attributes.description: The donor's own reference number or grant award number associated with this obligation, where the obligation is tied to a specific donor-funded grant. Enables traceability from obligation to donor grant for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The agreed deadline by which the obligation must be fulfilled, as specified in the partnership instrument. Drives automated reminders, escalation triggers, and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the end event occurred for this mou obligation.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this obligation was formally escalated to senior management, the donor, or a dispute resolution mechanism due to non-fulfillment or contested completion.

attributes.name: escalation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the reason for escalation, actions taken, and resolution steps. Captures the escalation history for audit and learning purposes.

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation has been escalated due to non-compliance or dispute: none (no escalation), flagged (internally noted as at-risk), escalated (formally raised to senior management or donor), or resolved (escalation closed after remediation).

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence submitted to demonstrate fulfillment of this obligation (e.g., 'Quarterly narrative report submitted via email on 2024-03-31', 'Training attendance register and photos uploaded to SharePoint'). Supports audit and compliance review.

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, URL, or unique document identifier pointing to the supporting evidence artifact (report, photo, attendance list, financial statement) that demonstrates fulfillment of this obligation.

attributes.name: financial_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value associated with this obligation where it involves a financial commitment (e.g., sub-grant tranche disbursement, in-kind contribution valuation, or cost-sharing commitment). Null for non-financial obligations.

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Sub-national geographic scope of the obligation (e.g., region, district, camp, or settlement name) where the deliverable is to be executed. Supports GIS-based field operations monitoring.

attributes.name: indicator_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific KPI or MEL indicator that this obligation contributes to, as defined in the partnership's MEAL framework or donor reporting requirements. Supports DHIS2 indicator tracking and MEL dashboard reporting.

attributes.name: is_critical_obligation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this obligation is classified as critical to the partnership's core deliverables or donor compliance requirements. Critical obligations trigger priority escalation workflows and are highlighted in SitRep and donor reporting.

attributes.name: is_donor_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether fulfillment of this obligation must be reported to the donor (e.g., USAID BHA, DFID, CERF). Drives inclusion in donor compliance reports and IATI activity updates.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this obligation record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: logframe_output_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or label linking this obligation to a specific output, outcome, or activity in the partnership's Logical Framework (LogFrame) or Theory of Change (ToC). Enables Results-Based Management (RBM) tracking and MEL alignment.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the modified event occurred for this mou obligation.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the mou obligation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or internal commentary related to this obligation that does not fit into structured fields. Used by partnership managers for operational notes and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the obligation, deliverable, or commitment as defined in the partnership instrument. Captures the full scope, quality standards, and acceptance criteria agreed upon by both parties.

attributes.name: obligation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or clause reference identifying this obligation within the partnership instrument (e.g., 'MOU-2024-001-OBL-03', or clause reference 'Section 4.2.1'). Used in partner communications and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the obligation: pending (not yet started), in_progress (work underway), completed (fulfilled and verified), overdue (past due date without completion), waived (formally excused by mutual agreement), or disputed (fulfillment contested by either party).

attributes.name: obligation_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the obligation or deliverable (e.g., 'Quarterly Program Progress Report', 'WASH Training for 50 Community Health Workers'). Used in dashboards and partner communications.

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the obligation by its nature: deliverable (tangible output), reporting (narrative or data submission), financial (fund transfer or accounting), capacity_building (training or institutional strengthening), coordination (attendance at cluster/working group meetings), or compliance (regulatory or donor requirement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deliverable|reporting|financial|capacity_building|coordination|compliance — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: operational_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where this obligation is to be fulfilled. Enables geographic filtering and country-level compliance reporting.

attributes.name: program_sector
attributes.description: The humanitarian or development sector to which this obligation relates (e.g., WASH, GBV, Health, Education, Food Security, Shelter, PSS, Nutrition). Aligns with OCHA cluster system and IATI sector codes for cross-program reporting.

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is a one-time commitment or a recurring one, and if recurring, the frequency: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or ad_hoc. Drives automated scheduling of future obligation instances.

attributes.name: reminder_days_before_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the due_date that an automated reminder notification should be triggered to the responsible focal point and partnership manager. Configurable per obligation based on complexity and risk.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the reporting or performance period to which this obligation applies. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the window for periodic compliance obligations.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting or performance period to which this obligation applies. Used for periodic obligations (e.g., quarterly reports, monthly financial submissions) to align with donor reporting cycles.

attributes.name: responsible_focal_point_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual designated as the primary focal point accountable for fulfilling this obligation on behalf of the responsible party. Used for escalation and follow-up communications.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Indicates which party bears primary responsibility for fulfilling this obligation: lead_organization (the NGO itself), partner_organization (the CSO, CBO, INGO, or government counterpart), both_parties (joint obligation), or third_party (a designated sub-contractor or consortium member).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the start event occurred for this mou obligation.

attributes.name: mou_obligation_status
attributes.description: Current status indicator for the mou obligation workflow state.

attributes.name: target_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the target value (e.g., 'beneficiaries', 'households', 'training sessions', 'metric tons', 'reports'). Required when target_value is populated to give the quantity business meaning.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Quantitative target associated with this obligation (e.g., number of beneficiaries to be reached, number of training sessions to be conducted, quantity of NFIs to be distributed). Null for qualitative obligations.

attributes.name: verified_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member or authorized representative who verified and accepted the fulfillment evidence for this obligation on behalf of the receiving party.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receiving party formally verified and accepted the evidence of fulfillment for this obligation. Distinct from completion_date, which is when the responsible party submitted the deliverable.

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this obligation was formally waived by mutual agreement of both parties. Required when obligation_status is 'waived'. Documents the business rationale for audit and compliance purposes.

products.name: partner_accreditation
products.description: Tracks formal accreditations, certifications, and standards compliance held by partner organizations including CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) certification, Sphere compliance, HAP membership, ISO certifications, and national NGO registration status. Captures accreditation body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, and verification status. Supports due diligence and quality assurance.
products.reference: CHS Certification / Sphere Compliance / NGO Accreditation

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each partner accreditation record. Primary key for the partner_accreditation data product.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization that holds this accreditation. Links to the partner_org master record.

attributes.name: accreditation_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or identifier for the accreditation scheme (e.g., 'CHS', 'SPHERE', 'HAP', 'ISO9001', 'ISO27001', 'NGO-REG'). Used for filtering, reporting, and cross-partner comparisons in MEL dashboards.

attributes.name: accreditation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the accreditation, certification, or standard (e.g., 'Core Humanitarian Standard Certification', 'ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management', 'Sphere Humanitarian Standards Compliance', 'HAP Membership', 'National NGO Registration – Kenya'). Human-readable label used in due diligence reports and partner dashboards.

attributes.name: accreditation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or rating assigned by the accrediting body upon assessment, where applicable (e.g., CHS self-assessment score out of 100, ISO audit score). Null if the accreditation is pass/fail with no numeric score. Used in partner capacity assessment scoring and due diligence risk rating calculations.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accreditation record. 'active' indicates the accreditation is valid and in force; 'expired' indicates the validity period has lapsed; 'suspended' indicates temporary withdrawal by the accrediting body; 'pending_renewal' indicates renewal application submitted; 'withdrawn' indicates permanent revocation; 'under_review' indicates the accrediting body is conducting a review.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Broad category of the accreditation record. Distinguishes between formal certifications (e.g., CHS, ISO), membership bodies (e.g., HAP), national NGO registrations, compliance standards (e.g., Sphere), licenses, and awards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: certification|membership|registration|compliance_standard|license|award — promote to reference product if additional values emerge]

attributes.name: accrediting_body_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the accrediting body is domiciled or where the registration is issued (e.g., 'CHE' for Switzerland-based CHS Alliance, 'GBR' for UK Charity Commission). Supports geographic compliance analysis.

attributes.name: accrediting_body_name
attributes.description: Full name of the organization or authority that issued the accreditation or certification (e.g., 'CHS Alliance', 'Sphere Association', 'Bureau Veritas', 'Kenya NGO Coordination Board', 'ISO Certification Body'). Critical for verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: applicable_standard_version
attributes.description: Version or edition of the standard or framework against which the accreditation was assessed (e.g., 'CHS 2018', 'Sphere 2018', 'ISO 9001:2015'). Important for tracking compliance against evolving standards and identifying partners certified to outdated versions.

attributes.name: assessment_level
attributes.description: Indicates the rigor and methodology of the accreditation assessment. 'full' denotes a comprehensive third-party audit; 'partial' denotes assessment of selected components; 'self_assessment' denotes partner-reported compliance without external verification; 'third_party' denotes independent external audit; 'peer_review' denotes assessment by peer organizations. Informs the weight given to the accreditation in due diligence scoring.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or registration number issued by the accrediting body. Serves as the externally-known unique identifier for the accreditation document. Used for verification with the issuing body and referenced in due diligence reports and donor compliance submissions.

attributes.name: chs_commitment_level
attributes.description: For CHS-specific accreditations, records the highest CHS commitment level achieved by the partner organization (Commitments 1–9 per the CHS framework). Null for non-CHS accreditations. Supports CHS-aligned partner quality benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commitment_1|commitment_2|commitment_3|commitment_4|commitment_5|commitment_6|commitment_7|commitment_8|commitment_9 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the partner accreditation classification or category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accreditation record was first created in the system. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description providing context about the partner accreditation.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the scanned certificate or official accreditation document stored in Ngo's document repository. Enables auditors and compliance staff to retrieve the source document for verification.

attributes.name: document_upload_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation certificate document was uploaded to Ngo's document management system. Used to assess document currency and flag records where the uploaded document may be outdated relative to the most recent renewal. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: donor_reference
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the donor that mandates this accreditation as a grant or sub-award condition (e.g., 'USAID/BHA', 'FCDO', 'CERF'). Populated only when donor_required is True. Supports grant compliance reporting and sub-award management.

attributes.name: donor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific accreditation is required by a donor as a condition of a grant or sub-award agreement. True if mandated by a donor (e.g., USAID, DFID/FCDO, CERF); False otherwise. Supports grant compliance tracking and sub-award due diligence.

attributes.name: due_diligence_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this accreditation in Ngo's partner due diligence scoring model (e.g., 0.25 for 25% weight). Reflects the relative importance of this accreditation type in the overall partner risk rating calculation. Configured by the Partnership team in alignment with donor requirements.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the end event occurred for this partner accreditation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certification, or registration expires and must be renewed. Null for accreditations with no fixed expiry. Used to trigger renewal workflows and flag partners with lapsed credentials in due diligence reviews. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: Country or region where this accreditation is valid and recognized. May be a specific ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., 'KEN', 'ETH'), a regional designation, or 'GLOBAL' for internationally recognized accreditations. Supports geographic due diligence and partner deployment decisions.

attributes.name: iati_activity_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Activity Identifier
attributes.description: IATI activity identifier associated with the partnership or program context in which this accreditation was assessed or required. Supports IATI-compliant transparency reporting and donor traceability.

tag_set.value: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Activity Identifier

attributes.name: is_mandatory_for_partnership
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation is a mandatory prerequisite for Ngo to enter into or maintain a partnership agreement with this organization. True if required by Ngo's partnership policy, donor conditions, or regulatory requirements; False if optional or informational. Drives partnership eligibility checks.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrediting body formally issued or granted the accreditation, certification, or registration. Marks the start of the accreditation's validity period. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: max_possible_score
attributes.description: The maximum score achievable under the accreditation assessment framework, used to contextualize the accreditation_score (e.g., 100 for a percentage-based CHS assessment). Null if the accreditation is pass/fail. Enables normalized cross-partner comparisons.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the modified event occurred for this partner accreditation.

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the partner accreditation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, conditions, limitations, or observations related to this accreditation record. May include details of any conditions attached to the accreditation, findings from the assessment, or follow-up actions required. Used by partnership officers during due diligence reviews.

attributes.name: renewal_alert_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the accreditation expiry_date at which an automated renewal alert should be triggered for the partnership management team. Configurable per accreditation type (e.g., 90 days for CHS certification, 30 days for national NGO registration). Supports proactive compliance management.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the partner organization submitted or is scheduled to submit a renewal application for this accreditation. attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope, coverage, or applicability of the accreditation. Specifies which programs, sectors, geographic areas, or operational activities the accreditation covers (e.g., 'WASH and shelter programs in East Africa', 'Financial management systems only'). Supports targeted due diligence assessments.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the start event occurred for this partner accreditation.

attributes.name: partner_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current status indicator for the partner accreditation workflow state.

attributes.name: thematic_sector
attributes.description: The humanitarian or development sector to which this accreditation primarily applies (e.g., 'WASH', 'GBV', 'Health', 'Education', 'Shelter', 'Food Security', 'PSS'). attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accreditation record was most recently modified. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which Ngo staff last verified the accreditation with the issuing body. Used to assess how current the verification is and to schedule re-verification cycles. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: verification_status
